title: Upgraded NSW Digital Photo Card pilot – Privacy collection notice
summary: This notice explains how Service NSW collects and uses personal information when participating in the upgraded NSW Digital Photo Card pilot.

faqs.q: Am I required by law to provide this personal information?
faqs.a: No, you are not required by law to provide this information.

faqs.q: How will my personal information be used?
faqs.a: The information will be used to verify your identity, generate and update your upgraded NSW Digital Photo Card, and for internal administrative purposes, including fraud detection.

faqs.q: Will my biometric data be stored?
faqs.a: Service NSW will not retain biometric information captured during the face verification process; they only retain a record of the outcome.
